name: WavCaps: Weakly-Labelled Audio Captioning Benchmark
description: WavCaps is a large-scale audio-language multimodal dataset comprising 403,050 audio clips paired with ChatGPT-assisted descriptive captions. The audio is sourced from 4 distinct collections: FreeSound (262,300 clips), AudioSet strongly-labelled subset (108,317 clips), BBC Sound Effects (31,201 clips), and SoundBible (1,232 clips). Sourced descriptions were filtered and re-written using ChatGPT into natural language captions describing acoustic events, spatial scene properties, and sound sources, supporting audio-language retrieval, automated audio captioning (AAC), and zero-shot sound classification.
